description: This file defines the Smarty_Security class, which manages security settings and checks for the Smarty templating engine, including trusted functions, classes, tags, URIs, and resource directories.

classes.name: Smarty_Security
classes.description: Class managing security policies for Smarty templates, including trusted functions, classes, tags, URIs, and resource directories.

methods.name: isTrustedPhpFunction
methods.description: Checks if a PHP function is trusted based on security settings.

methods.name: isTrustedStaticClass
methods.description: Checks if a static class is trusted.

methods.name: isTrustedStaticClassAccess
methods.description: Checks if access to a static class method or property is trusted.

methods.name: isTrustedPhpModifier
methods.description: Checks if a PHP modifier is trusted.

methods.name: isTrustedTag
methods.description: Checks if a template tag is trusted.

methods.name: isTrustedSpecialSmartyVar
methods.description: Checks if a special $smarty variable is trusted.

methods.name: isTrustedModifier
methods.description: Checks if a modifier plugin is trusted.

methods.name: isTrustedConstant
methods.description: Checks if a constant is trusted or permitted.

methods.name: isTrustedStream
methods.description: Checks if a stream is trusted.

methods.name: isTrustedResourceDir
methods.description: Checks if a resource directory of a file is trusted.

methods.name: isTrustedUri
methods.description: Checks if a URI is trusted based on patterns.

methods.name: isTrustedPHPDir
methods.description: Checks if a PHP directory is trusted.

methods.name: _updateResourceDir
methods.description: Updates the resource directory cache by removing old directories and adding new ones.

methods.name: _checkDir
methods.description: Checks if a file is inside a trusted directory.

methods.name: enableSecurity
methods.description: Enables security policy on a Smarty instance with a given security class.

methods.name: startTemplate
methods.description: Starts template processing, enforcing max nesting level.

methods.name: endTemplate
methods.description: Ends template processing, decreasing nesting level.

methods.name: registerCallBacks
methods.description: Registers start/end callbacks for template rendering.
